repo.description:
### Impact

Posts hidden by community flags or staff action could be disclosed to people who were not permitted to view them.

An anonymous visitor with a topic URL could read the full raw body of a hidden first post in the topic RSS feed’s channel description. The topic’s HTML description and Open Graph and Twitter metadata could also expose excerpts from a hidden first or requested post, including when a visitor requested a visible reply. Separately, digest emails could include an excerpt from a hidden reply selected as the topic’s highest-scored post.

In a default configuration, hidden posts are visible to their authors, staff, and trust level 4 users. This issue allowed anonymous visitors and ordinary users to obtain content they should not have been able to read. It did not allow modification of posts or escalation of privileges

### Workarounds

No known complete workaround is available. Updating to a fixed version is recommended.
repo.summary: Hidden post content may be exposed in RSS feeds, metadata, and digest emails
